华法林与唑类抗真菌药物相互作用及其机制研究进展
Research of the interaction and their mechanisms between warfarin and azole antifungal agents
刘瑜新1，2 ，傅静兰2，3 ，夏霄彤2，3 ，陈文君2，3 ，吴婷婷2，3 ，张进华2，3( 1. 河南大学淮河医院药学部，河南开封475000. 2. 福建医科大学附属协和医院药学部，福建福州 350001. 3. 福建医科大学药学院，福建福州 350001)Abstract: Warfarin is widely used in clinic because of its low price，specific antagonist and definite therapeutic evaluation index. Adverse events about the interaction between azole antifungal agents and warfarin have been reported. But little attention has been paid to this. The metabolic pathways of warfarin and azole antifungal drugs were discussed in this paper，combined with the reports of the interaction between the two drugs. To elucidate the interaction and mechanism of warfarin with different azole antifungal agents.LIU Yu － xin1，2 ，FU Jing － lan2，3 ，XIA Xiao － tong2，3 ，CHEN Wen － jun2，3 ，ZHANG Jin － hua2，3( 1.
